title: Buyers run the highs, sellers take the group back
premise: Watch the group profiles as the market climbs. One group pokes over the high of the three before it, closes back below, and its heaviest row sits near the bottom where sellers out-traded buyers. That is the SELL ▼.

chapters.title: FIGHT NODE
chapters.text: A FIGHT node at 26,640.00–26,641.17: 188 contracts, 3.7σ above the group's average row, 123 bought against 65 sold. Both sides committed at one price.

chapters.title: SELL ▼
chapters.text: The group runs over 26,691.75, the high of the three groups before it, and closes back below. Delta flips +197 → −267; the POC (26,670.89–26,672.04) sits in the bottom 35%, where sellers out-traded buyers.

chapters.title: FIGHT NODE
chapters.text: A FIGHT node at 26,664.71–26,665.84: 894 contracts, 3.3σ above the group's average row, 424 bought against 470 sold. Both sides committed at one price.
